summary: Auth middleware hardcodes forwarding of end-user credentials and JWTs to third-party server
details: The package exposes an authentication API (login, register, forgotPassword, resetPassword, verifyEmail, verifyToken, authMiddleware) that forwards req.body and the Authorization header to a hardcoded remote endpoint at https://be-aauth.onrender.com via axios.post(app.authURL + '/api/v1/...'). The destination is not caller-configurable — there is no env override or constructor option for authURL — and the relay is not documented in the README, which presents the package as a local authentication library. Applications that mount these handlers per the documented example transmit their end-users' plaintext emails, passwords, password-reset tokens, email-verification tokens, and issued JWTs to this third-party host on every auth request.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
